title: Unrestricted reduction complexes and canonical comparison constructions
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R$ and uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and any scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme] with its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $C_n=(R/\varpi^{n+1})_X$, $B=\varprojlim_n C_n$ and $\pi_n:B\to C_n$ be the completed coefficient datum [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Use the module categories, their standard derived localizations and scalar restriction [def-sf-scalar-reduction-categories-restriction], and canonical derived scalar extension $L\pi_n^*$ [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction]. For any cochain complex $P$ of $B$-module sheaves define its finite reduction by ordinary change of rings $C_n\otimes_B-$ applied termwise [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and its unrestricted reduction $T_n(P)$ by restricting this complex back to $B$. For $s\in C_n(U)$ and $x\in M(U)$ define the pure tensor section by sheafifying $s\otimes x$ and transporting through the defining object equality of scalar extension. For a K-flat resolution $q:P\to G$ [def-pc-kflat-complex], define the canonical computation isomorphism $L\pi_n^*(QG)\simeq Q(C_n\otimes_B P)$ using $L\pi_n^*(Qq)^{-1}$, the universal derived scalar-extension counit and the standard localization comparisons [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Define $T_{n+1}(P)\to T_n(P)$ by evaluating the canonical quotient-transition natural transformation at $P$, sending each pure tensor $s\otimes x$ to $q_n(s)\otimes x$ for the coefficient quotient $q_n:C_{n+1}\to C_n$. The functor instances use ordinary scalar-extension additivity and exact restriction. No construction is selected from the theorem asserting resolution independence of the tower.
